q97bw4qp.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
q97bw4qp.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Mini Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
q97bw4qp.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree captures the holiday magic with its vibrant design and season-inspired aesthetic. Perfect for those seeking a modern twist on a traditional favorite, this tree marries simplicity with elegance, fitting seamlessly into any living room, garden, or terrace. The contemporary style—characterized by clean lines and minimal ornamentation—brings a sleek look to any festive setting, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere. PVC and Steel Build: Constructed from a blend of PVC and steel, this artificial tree offers a robust structure designed to last season after season. The abrasion-resistant material ensures longevity, while the steel stand provides excellent stability, easy to assemble with just a screwdriver. Energy-Efficient LED Lights: Equipped with LED string lights, this tree features energy-saving properties and dynamic lighting patterns. With 8 distinct flash modes, these lights illuminate the tree in intricate patterns, creating vibrant light displays that enhance any holiday décor. Convenient USB Power Source: This tree's innovative USB connectivity offers flexible power options, making it easy to power up without needing a traditional outlet. Simply plug it into a portable power bank or any compatible device, offering hassle-free setup. Stylish Modern Design: The cone-shaped frame and modern design elements make this tree a stylish addition to homes or outdoor spaces with shelter. Its sleek appearance fits smoothly into minimalist or contemporary setups, enhancing the visual appeal of any seasonal scene. Easy Assembly and Care: Designed for ease, assembling this tree is simple. With only a screwdriver and a partner needed, it's ready to impress. Follow care instructions for assembly efficiently, ensuring the tree remains a staple holiday decoration for years. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 380 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Purple Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

vhds5107.sourceDescription: Create a warm and festive welcome with these Christmas door garland lights, featuring 800 micro LED lights across a 5.5m illuminated length for a bright, eye-catching seasonal display. With eight lighting modes, including Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slo-Glo, Chasing/Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash and Steady On, you can customise the lighting to suit your festive décor. The built-in timer provides six hours of illumination followed by an automatic 18-hour off cycle, with simple ON/OFF controls for convenient operation. Mains powered with a 5m lead cable, these lights offer flexible placement around your home. The IP44 weather-resistant rating makes them suitable for indoor and outdoor use, including decorating front doors, garlands, staircases, Christmas trees, fireplaces and banisters. Specifications: 800 micro LED lights, 5.5m illuminated length, eight lighting modes, built-in six-hour timer with an 18-hour off cycle, ON/OFF control, 5m mains power lead, IP44 weather-resistant rating and suitable for indoor and outdoor Christmas decorations.
